goal: Five comparable design concepts for existing Workspace app, grounded in live UI and web references, preserving all function access.
hypothesis: Live-app inventory plus five grounded visual directions and explicit access mapping enables informed design selection without changing app behavior.
scope: Design artifacts and isolated app fixtures only; no product implementation, live user data changes or publication.

checks.description: Actual app launched with isolated data, screens captured and existing actions inventoried; fails if only code or invented interface used.
Product source and original .workspace files unchanged; fails on modification.

Five independently generated visual directions of the same Board screen and same six project names/statuses, with distinct composition, typography, palette and density; fails if missing, indistinguishable or different data.
Russian analysis, functional access mapping, sourced web references, tradeoffs and recommendation provided; fails if actions lost or sources absent.
Five image files and local readable gallery/report exist and open; fails on broken images/links or missing outputs.
